name: Ohanabatake no Flore
source:
New title in Magic Witch Parfait universe.
The story is about Flore, Parfait and Rinette who are 11 years old and like growing flowers. Grow over 50 different varieties of flowers with them!

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/11/vn-of-month-january-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
《魔法少女芭菲》世界观下的新作。
故事围绕11岁的芙萝蕾、芭菲与蕾妮特展开，她们都很喜欢种花。与三人一起培育超过50种不同的花朵吧！

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/11/vn-of-month-january-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
